title: Crossword
description: A crossword made from a list of words and clues. The grid is generated for you; learners type the words and check them.
demoHtml:
<crossword-puzzle question="Web basics mini">
  <input value="HTML" data-clue="Markup language of the web" /><input value="HREF" data-clue="Attribute that holds a link's destination" /><input value="LINK" data-clue="Element that loads a stylesheet" /><input value="FORK" data-clue="Copy a repo to your own account" />
</crossword-puzzle>

attributes.name: accent-color
attributes.description: Optional accent for the chip, the active word and the action buttons: a color name such as "blue" or "green" (see DDDAccent.js)

gizmo.title: Crossword
gizmo.description: A crossword made from a list of words and clues. The grid is generated for you; learners type the words and check them.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: The title or question shown above the crossword.

configure.title: Words
configure.description: Each word and its clue. The grid is generated from this list: the longest word is placed first and the others cross it on shared letters.

properties.title: Word
properties.description: The answer. Spaces and punctuation are left out of the grid.

properties.title: Clue
properties.description: What learners read to work out the word.

advanced.title: Attempts
advanced.description: How many times a learner can check. 0 means unlimited.

advanced.title: Accent color
advanced.description: Optional color for the header chip, the active word and the action buttons.

advanced.title: Collapsible
advanced.description: Show this crossword as a row that opens and closes. Opening one closes the other collapsible questions beside it.

advanced.title: Start collapsed
advanced.description: When collapsible, start as a closed row that shows only the title and its status.

advanced.title: Grading format
advanced.description: OER Schema: grading format for this assessment (e.g. points, letter, percent, completion).

advanced.title: Learning objective
advanced.description: OER Schema: learning objective associated with this assessment.

developer.title: Name of the quiz
developer.description: Quiz name used for xAPI identification in analytics systems.

developer.title: Course
developer.description: OER Schema: course this assessment is intended for.
